item.title: MiniBar (1.0.7)
item.description:
Version: 1.0.7
Author: Simbo
Category: Action Bars & Main Bar
Updated: 2026-09-03 20:18 UTC
Downloads: 2,308
File: 1788466692-MiniBar.zip (63.9 KB)

MiniBar is a plugin that provides a set of easily customisable toolbars that can be minimised when not needed. It is designed primarily for items and actions you do not need very often and so can be hidden away into a corner of the screen until needed.

Instructions for use

Click on the arrow icon to the right of the title to expand or collapse the bar. Drag and drop icons on to the bar just like normal toolbars
To add edit or remove toolbars click on the settings icon to the left of the title
To switch between toolbars rightclick on the title and select another from...

Welcome to MysticBars
the plugin formerly known as TonicBars
The concept is a Bar quickbar manager. It will allow you to create Bars and manage different attributes for them. To compliment traditional bars is a new concept called Extensions. item.title: Build Swapper (1.03)
item.description:
Version: 1.03
Author: harman097
Category: Action Bars & Main Bar
Updated: 2013-02-17 03:37 UTC
Downloads: 54,053
File: 1361072270-Turwe.zip (31.9 KB)

This plugin allows for the creation of Quickslot Sequences as well as the creation and placing of extra single Quickslots. Quickslot Sequences can be used to simplify gearswapping combine easy gearswapping with skill execution or just clean up your real quickslots a bit. Basically how a Quickslot Sequence works is you enter up to 30 quickslot actions items skills shortcuts etc. and they get condensed into one Quickslot that you can place anywhere on the screen. When you click it it cycles to the next one allowing you to just spamclick one quickslot to perform a bunch of actions. I...
